baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of ذ ك ر at words 2 and 4 enclose ن ف ع at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The subject's act of bringing something back to mind and the reminder that makes it present form two ends of a feedback loop. Benefit is the conversion occurring between them, not a detachable reward added afterward.

activation_trace.role: Bringing a thing back to mind supplies the recipient-side activation that begins the loop.
A reminder that makes a matter present supplies the external or repeatable activation that completes the loop.
Benefit as the opposite of harm names the positive state-change produced when recall becomes effective.

changed_reading.before: He may remember and then receive some generic benefit from the reminder.
changed_reading.after: His incipient recollection may be caught and completed by the reminder, converting a latent trace into an active benefit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ذ ك ر construction can keep inward recollection and outward mention simultaneously available.
baseline_models.mechanism: What is internally recalled can be put on the tongue, and voiced mention can in turn keep it present. The benefit arises through recirculation between inward memory and outward articulation.

activation_trace.role: Mental recollection supplies the inward phase of the recirculating process.
Mention running on the tongue supplies an outward rehearsal that can return the matter to awareness.
Positive benefit is the functional gain produced by repeated inward and outward uptake.

changed_reading.before: Remembering is a silent, one-time mental event.
changed_reading.after: Remembering may become beneficial by circulating through voiced mention and renewed inward recollection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ can activate the ذ ك ر branch of a document that records a right, while تَنفَعَهُ keeps practical efficacy in view.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reminder can be carried as more than transient mental content: it can function like a durable claim or instrument whose re-presentation makes a benefit realizable.

activation_trace.role: A document of right supplies the durable claim-like form of the reminder.
The reminder that restores presence supplies the act by which the durable claim becomes operative again.
Benefit supplies the practical consequence of recognizing or activating the claim.

changed_reading.before: The reminder is fleeting counsel that may improve the listener's state.
changed_reading.after: The reminder may also act like a recoverable instrument: when brought forward, it can make a latent entitlement or obligation practically effective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence repeatedly opens and closes a route between a seeking recipient and the reminder: facial constriction and turning away close it, arrival and purposeful movement approach it, and selective self-direction or distraction controls attention. The focus possibility is therefore an attention-gated causal chain, not a prediction about a fixed type of person.

activation_trace.role: The reminder that restores presence is the content whose route to the recipient can be opened or blocked.
Benefit is the possible output that depends on whether attention permits uptake.
A face contracting in displeasure supplies the first interpersonal closure of the access route.
Turning away supplies the bodily withdrawal that can interrupt delivery of the reminder.
Arrival supplies the recipient's successful movement into possible contact.
Self-sufficiency supplies a posture that can close the recipient to needed benefit.
Directing oneself toward something supplies selective allocation of the speaker's attention.
Purposeful motion toward a sought object supplies active recipient-side pursuit rather than passive exposure.
Being occupied away from one thing by another supplies the competing-attention mechanism that blocks uptake.

structural_cues: The sequence 80:1-10 alternates withdrawal and approach on both the speaker and recipient sides of 80:4.
The focus clause itself remains modal, so the sequence exposes a possible pathway rather than certifying an outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: constricted face, withdrawal, arrival, self-sufficiency, selective orientation, purposeful approach, and distraction. Reader arrow: these motions regulate access to the reminder and therefore its efficacy. Live alternative: the sequence may only rank audiences ethically, without making attention a causal gate.

changed_reading.before: The listener either happens to remember or does not.
changed_reading.after: The listener's latent capacity may become beneficial when a seeking movement is met by an open channel of attention; social allocation helps determine whether the possibility can activate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Physical non-seeing, the addressee's lack of knowledge, and possible growth combine to detach receptivity from visible status. The benefit in 80:4 is an inward capacity whose presence cannot be inferred from outward appearance.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something to mind supplies an inward event that need not be externally visible.
Positive benefit supplies the hidden outcome whose possibility is being misread.
Loss of physical sight supplies the outward condition that fails to disclose inward receptivity.
Knowledge supplies the explicitly withheld assessment of what may occur inside the recipient.
Growth and increase supply a latent positive development unavailable to surface inspection.

structural_cues: 80:2 names an outward sensory lack immediately before 80:3 denies knowledge of a possible inward change.
The أَوْ of 80:4 adds recollective benefit as another live but unobservable possibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: physical blindness, an explicit knowledge gap, and possible growth. Reader arrow: visible capacity is an unreliable proxy for mnemonic receptivity. Live alternative: the cues may establish only uncertainty about moral response, without an inward-sight contrast.

changed_reading.before: The verse makes a weak guess that an apparently limited recipient might still profit.
changed_reading.after: The verse corrects the act of judging receptivity from surfaces: an unseen recollective capacity may already be poised to turn reminder into growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exploratory rights-instrument baseline gains a transmission chain: a reminder is restated, placed in written sheets, handled, disclosed through a book-bearing or mediating function, and later aligned with an obligation whose right is to be fulfilled. Benefit can therefore be the practical effect of a preserved record becoming present to its addressee.

activation_trace.role: A document recording a right supplies the focus reading's durable legal or evidentiary instrument.
Practical benefit supplies the realized effect of presenting and recognizing the instrument.
The explicit reminder supplies a context-side confirmation that the matter is designed for renewed presence.
A written sheet supplies durable inscription rather than fleeting speech.
Hand-to-hand presentation supplies custody and transfer of the inscribed reminder.
A book that reveals what is written supplies disclosure of the preserved content.
Performance and full satisfaction of a right supplies the endpoint at which the instrument becomes effective.
An obligatory demand supplies the normative content that the preserved reminder may carry.

structural_cues: 80:11-16 moves from reminder and recollection to honored sheets, hands, and mediators.
80:23 later frames the human failure as an obligation not yet completed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: reminder, written sheets, transfer by hands, disclosure of writing, obligation, and satisfaction of a right. Reader arrow: these form a record-to-performance chain that strengthens the focus branch of a rights document. Live alternative: the sheet sequence may indicate preservation and dignity without any legal-instrument force.

changed_reading.before: Reminder is mental counsel whose benefit ends in private recollection.
changed_reading.after: Reminder may be a preserved claim carried into the present, with benefit arising when its recorded demand is recognized and performed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence supplies dormancy, concealment, revival, unfolding, and completion. Read back into 80:4, recollection is not acquisition of foreign content but reanimation of something retained yet inactive; the reminder benefits by reopening and completing a latent trace.

activation_trace.role: Bringing a retained thing back to mind supplies the return of an inactive trace.
A reminder that restores presence supplies the reactivating stimulus.
Benefit supplies the positive function recovered when the trace becomes active.
Stillness or dormancy supplies an inactive state that is not necessarily annihilation.
Hiddenness and lowering supply storage below present awareness.
Reviving what was dead supplies the strongest context image for restored activity.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the expansion of the restored trace into consequences.
Completion supplies the unrealized endpoint toward which beneficial recollection moves.

structural_cues: 80:18-23 orders origin, measured formation, an opened path, death, concealment, revival, and unfinished completion.
The focus itself repeats one root around the beneficial verb, already giving recall a return structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: dormant stillness, hiddenness, revival, unfolding, and incompletion. Reader arrow: the bodily life-cycle sequence scales down analogically to the activation state of remembered content. Live alternative: the sequence may remain strictly anthropological and eschatological, merely illustrating divine power rather than mnemonic process.

changed_reading.before: A new piece of advice enters the listener and helps him.
changed_reading.after: The reminder reanimates a buried but retained trace, unfolds it into present awareness, and may carry it toward an unfinished beneficial action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The food sequence decomposes benefit into stages: directed attention, an input poured in, a receptive surface opened, seed emergence, growth, and eventual usable provision. The reminder's efficacy can therefore be delayed and germinative rather than an instantaneous act of persuasion.

activation_trace.role: The reminder supplies the initiating input placed before the recipient.
Benefit supplies the mature positive yield of the staged process.
Directing sight or insight toward something supplies the attention required before uptake.
Sustenance and livelihood supply the target analogy of an input becoming continued life.
Pouring supplies abundant delivery of the activating input.
Splitting and opening supply the receptive breach through which the input can enter.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the delayed appearance of a previously latent response.
A seed that grows and bears further seed supplies self-propagating retention rather than one-time impact.
Enjoyed and usable benefit supplies the final yield of the cultivation chain.

structural_cues: 80:24 commands attention before 80:25-32 unfolds a long causal chain from water to usable provision.
Repeated cognate constructions in 80:25 and 80:26 slow the sequence into distinct delivery and opening stages.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: attention, sustenance, pouring, opening, emergence, seed, and usable benefit. Reader arrow: the recipient is treated analogically as a receptive growing medium and the reminder as an input whose yield takes time. Live alternative: the agricultural chain may invite gratitude for food without modeling cognition.

changed_reading.before: A reminder either produces an immediate beneficial reaction or fails.
changed_reading.after: A reminder may enter through attention, remain latent, germinate, and only later become a usable and even self-propagating benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later collapse of bonds distinguishes support that can be supplied by another from a remembered benefit that has become one's own. Once flight, severed ties, and an all-occupying personal affair remove external supports, only internalized uptake remains portable.

activation_trace.role: Personal recollection supplies an inwardly retained resource that does not require another person to carry it.
Benefit supplies what must become effective for the singular recipient marked by the object pronoun.
Flight supplies the withdrawal of another person's support at the moment of need.
A binding tie supplies the strong relation that nevertheless fails to transfer responsibility.
Close companionship supplies another ordinarily durable support that is severed.
Each person's own affair supplies the non-transferable burden occupying the individual.
Sufficiency or adequacy supplies the affair's capacity to occupy each person without recourse to kin.

structural_cues: The branchless ص خ خ occurrence at 80:33 is used only as the structural boundary that begins the severance sequence.
80:34-37 moves from brother through parents, companion, and children before isolating each individual with an affair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: flight from binding kin and companionship, followed by each person's sufficient or occupying affair. Reader arrow: reminder becomes durable benefit only when personally internalized before those supports disappear. Live alternative: the sequence may concern accountability alone and say nothing about the portability of recollection.

changed_reading.before: The reminder helps an audience member within an ongoing social setting.
changed_reading.after: The reminder may become a personally retained benefit that remains available when relational support and borrowed standing can no longer be transferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing face sequence contrasts uncovering, inner fullness overflowing onto the surface, and outward-inward completion with dust, covering, and breached integrity. It activates recollection as an inward state that eventually becomes outwardly legible; benefit is integration that reaches the surface rather than remaining private information.

activation_trace.role: Restored inward presence supplies the hidden state that may later become visible.
Positive benefit supplies the integrated outcome that can reach outward expression.
Removing a covering supplies disclosure of what had been hidden.
The face as the forward surface supplies the place where inward outcome becomes legible.
Fullness that overflows into visibility supplies an inside-to-outside causal image.
Completion joining outward and inward states supplies the model's integration criterion.
Dust coloring the surface supplies the opposite case in which residue visibly coats the face.
Covering supplies suppression of what the reminder would bring into presence.
Breaching a cover and deviating from right supplies disintegration rather than beneficial disclosure.

structural_cues: 80:38-42 presents two face outcomes in direct contrast, making internal condition readable at a surface.
The sequence moves from uncovering and visible joy to coating, overpowering, covering, and breach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: uncovering, faces, inward fullness becoming visible, outward-inward completion, dust coating, covering, and breach. Reader arrow: mnemonic benefit integrates an inwardly restored state until it becomes outwardly legible. Live alternative: the face descriptions may be independent signs of judgment rather than outputs of recollection.

changed_reading.before: The reminder benefits as a private cognitive correction.
changed_reading.after: The reminder may integrate a restored inward state deeply enough that its benefit reaches the person's outward orientation and becomes visibly disclosed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the lexical staff branch of ن ف ع inside a verb and maps reminder onto mobility support. It remains anchored by تَنفَعَهُ itself and by the packet's blindness, purposeful movement, path, and easing cues. Downstream prose should render it only as a material analogy for enabling agency, not as the lexical gloss of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb تَنفَعَهُ activates the ن ف ع branch of a useful staff, while the repeated ذ ك ر supplies what that support consists in.

activation_trace.role: A beneficial staff supplies a concrete enabling aid rather than an abstract favorable outcome.
The reminder supplies the substance of the support that can be taken up and used.
Loss of sight supplies the condition under which a staff-like aid changes practical agency.
Purposeful motion supplies the agency that the aid enables rather than replaces.
An extended traversable path supplies the domain in which mnemonic support becomes useful.
Opening and ease after difficulty supply the functional result of using the support.

changed_reading.before: The reminder gives the blind seeker an abstract benefit.
changed_reading.after: The reminder may function like a staff: a support taken up by the seeker that enables purposeful movement along an otherwise difficult path.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the waterskin side-strip branch of ن ف ع with the form-distant outflow branch mapped from د ر ي. It remains anchored by the focus benefit verb and reminder noun, then gains a coherent flow, containment, opening, and growth sequence from the packet. Downstream prose should identify it as an exploratory hydraulic model, not as a claim that the words literally denote vessel parts or irrigation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb تَنفَعَهُ activates the side-strip of a waterskin as a structural image for how reminder can become usable rather than leak away.

activation_trace.role: The side strip supporting a waterskin supplies a containment structure that makes carried content usable.
The reminder supplies the content whose continued presence depends on reception and retention.
Abundant outflow from a source supplies the initial hydraulic motion in this form-distant activation.
Pouring supplies deliberate delivery of the flowing content.
Conveying water by irrigation or pouring supplies directed transmission rather than undifferentiated flow.
Opening the receiving surface supplies entry into what would otherwise remain closed.
Growth emerging from the opened ground supplies evidence that conveyed content was retained productively.

changed_reading.before: Benefit is the message's abstract payload.
changed_reading.after: Benefit may instead be the supporting and channeling structure that lets reminder flow be retained, enter a receptive opening, and produce growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the honorable-renown branch of ذ ك ر in forms ordinarily read as recollection and carries it into social visibility. It remains anchored by both focus occurrences of ذ ك ر and by the packet's withdrawal, honor, prestige, and outward-inward completion cues. Downstream prose should preserve it as a secondary social reading, not replace cognitive remembrance with reputation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated ذ ك ر can carry honorable mention alongside recollection, allowing benefit to include restored recognition of the person initially turned away from.

activation_trace.role: Honorable mention and renown supply a social consequence of being brought into remembrance.
Positive benefit supplies the repaired standing or recognition made available to the recipient.
Turning away supplies the initial withholding of social attention and visibility.
Praiseworthy honor supplies the context's positive valuation of what carries the reminder.
Prestige and social standing supply the public dimension of restored mention.
Completion joining outward and inward states keeps social visibility connected to genuine inward uptake.

changed_reading.before: Only the seeker's private memory can benefit.
changed_reading.after: His recollection may also expose a reversal of social valuation: the overlooked seeker becomes worthy of honorable mention and visible regard.

strongest_changes: The early approach and withdrawal sequence turned benefit into an attention-gated pathway rather than a fixed property of a recipient.
The death, concealment, revival, and completion sequence activated recollection as reanimation of a latent trace.
The food and growth sequence made reminder efficacy staged, delayed, germinative, and potentially self-propagating.
The written-sheet sequence strengthened an exploratory reading of reminder as a durable claim whose benefit appears in performance.
summary.what_was_special: The same compact focus construction sustained cognitive, vocal, documentary, ecological, social, and material mechanisms without forcing them into one reading. Most unusually, the staff and waterskin branches of ن ف ع became coherent enabling models when the packet supplied blindness and path, then flow and growth.
remaining_uncertainties: The legal reading depends on a form-distant ذ ك ر branch even though the later sheet and obligation sequence strengthens it.
The staff and waterskin readings are cross-domain analogies and should never be presented as direct lexical substitutions.
The life-cycle, cultivation, and face sequences may be independent arguments or outcomes rather than causal models of remembrance.
The vocal baseline remains live but receives less distinctive contextual support than the other retained models.
